stem: A legally permitted biological control is introduced after a pest diagnosis. What makes the intervention part of a defensible IPM program rather than a one-time treatment?
choices: Assuming efficacy because the product is biological
Combining prevention/cultural/environmental controls with documented application and follow-up scouting using the same measurement method
Changing several interventions simultaneously without records
rationale: Integrated pest management combines compatible preventive and corrective controls and measures outcomes against a repeatable baseline rather than assuming efficacy from a product category.
